sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mesonbuild/meson/<tag>/mesonbuild/mesonmain.py and environment.py (Python and Ninja version checks)
MSI inspection 2026-09-18: bundled pythonXY.dll/ninja.exe in 20 sampled MSIs; .pkg payload Mach-O inspection of 0.58.1, 1.1.1, 1.2.0, 1.2.2, 1.6.1, 1.7.0, 1.7.1, 1.8.0-1.8.2
recommendation: Default on every OS: install Meson as pure Python run by a Python the app already has, or by the catalogue's Python installed as its own runtime -- unpack the sdist into {runtime_dir} and run `python -s {runtime_dir}/meson.py`, or `pip install` the wheel into the app's own Python. Meson has no dependencies, so this needs no network and no compiler, works on Linux/macOS/Windows alike, and lets the Python pick decide the OS floor. Use the Windows MSI (extracted with msiexec /a) only when the app has no Python and the user's Windows meets the bundled Python's floor: it is self-contained (bundled Python + ninja.exe) but x64-only since 0.54, has no vendor checksum, and is missing for some releases. Don't use the macOS .pkg: it installs to /usr/local, is single-arch (x86_64 until 1.2.2, arm64-only from 1.6.1) and stopped after 1.8.2.
old_os: Windows XP: Meson 0.44.1 (last to accept Python 3.4) with the catalogue's Python 3.4 and Ninja 1.6.0 (x86, XP; Meson <0.54 needs ninja >=1.5). Meson 0.45-0.53.2 need Python 3.5, which only runs on XP via the operator-tested custom 3.5 backport. From 0.54 Meson needs ninja >=1.7, and every Ninja from 1.7.1 is x86-64 Vista+, so no newer Meson can build on XP or on 32-bit Windows. Windows Vista x64 / 7: Meson up to 1.11.x (Python 3.7/3.8) with the newest Ninja. Windows 8+: newest Meson (1.12 needs Python 3.10).
